findings.what: The 'left' list is incomplete under the closer's own declared scan criterion ('an inline every-point-on-an-inextensible-curve or hcover binder'). My elaborated scan of the eight source modules (forallTelescope, used constants) also flags three binders. (1) Causality.ers_lemma_4_70_core's inline htrans: through every point of U1 ⊓ U2 runs a curve inextensible in both components and meeting S in segments. (2) Causality.exists_box's hpart: a J+ ∪ J- cover of U. (3) Causality.Jplus_mem_nhds_of_isAcausal's hcov: a J+ ∪ J- cover of M. NestedCausalities has 7 hits, not the 3 + 2 + 1 listed. None is a CurvesExtend(On) binder, and none can be discharged by the curves theorem alone: htrans is the core lemma's content, and exists_box and Jplus_mem_nhds_of_isAcausal have no Cauchy hypothesis from which cover_of_t1_secondCountable could produce the cover. So no form is owed, and the 45-binder count and the 19 + 26 split stand.
findings.fix: Add the three to coverage.left with that reason (the lemma's content, not a curve-extension hypothesis), so that the next planner does not re-count them.

findings.what: The keeper note says 'every Cauchy surface is acausal' can take IsCauchySurface.isAcausal_of_t1_secondCountable under causally_arc_connected. programme/ladder.toml already records exactly that [[consequence]] (at = causally_arc_connected, standing [T1, second_countable], recorded since T-lad-record-curves-fact, 2026-11-21). Only the 'M = J+(Sigma) ∪ J-(Sigma)' entry (ladder.toml:3085-3089, witness mem_Jplus_union_Jminus_of_isCauchySurface) still lacks a second-countable witness. For that entry, IsCauchySurface.cover_of_t1_secondCountable (Causal.CauchySeparation, ETT-layer) is verified exact: the original less hext plus [T1Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M], with the same conclusion.
findings.fix: Tell the keeper that only the cover entry needs action. The acausality entry at causally_arc_connected already exists.
